headline: IMF Warns Kazakhstan's Construction Spending Poses Inflationary Risks
summary: The International Monetary Fund warned that Kazakhstan's large-scale construction program could fuel consumer inflation unless extensive public spending is matched by commensurate productivity gains.
why: Fiscal-driven stimulus in emerging markets often creates short-term GDP acceleration at the risk of currency weakness and persistent domestic price inflation.

impacts.name: Kazakhstan
impacts.why: Aggressive state infrastructure funding risks accelerating inflation if domestic supply chains cannot absorb capital.
